import sys


class Employee:
    def __init__(self):
        data = sys.stdin.readline().split()
        basic = float(data[0])
        hra = float(data[1])
        da = float(data[2])
        tax = float(data[3])

        gross = basic + (hra / 100.0) * basic + (da / 100.0) * basic
        net = gross - (tax / 100.0) * gross

        print(f"{net:.2f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    Employee()
